add_refused_note: There is no quantity-increasing pyramid or scale-in path in runner.py; grep for add_on/pyramid/scale_in returns nothing and every engine.place entry leg is gated on a flat own book. The ADD in this codebase is the crossover FLIP RE-OPEN, which re-establishes a position at the same bar as the close. It routes through _open_crossover_leg and is refused there, with its own skip record distinguishing it from a fresh open.
aggregate_type: PartialSum(_subtotal: float, unmeasured: frozenset[str]) plus a three-member Verdict enum (BREACHED/CLEAR/INDETERMINATE). Not a sentinel and not a number: it defines no __float__, __int__, __add__, __radd__, __sub__, __mul__, __neg__, __lt__, __le__, __gt__, __ge__ or __bool__.
how_enforced: Four independent teeth: (1) no numeric dunders, so realized + unreal and pnl <= -limit are TypeErrors at the call site; (2) exact() returns a float ONLY when complete and raises IncompleteAggregateError otherwise, so the sole accessor that yields an incomplete number returns a (float, frozenset) PAIR; (3) the verdict methods take a REQUIRED keyword-only declare sink and the type itself calls it whenever the aggregate is incomplete, so the declaration is emitted by the mechanism rather than by a caller who remembered; (4) an AST test fails CI if any verdict call site in runner.py satisfies declare= with a lambda, a constant, or anything other than a real _declare_degraded sink. plus() and times() carry the unmeasured set through arithmetic so it cannot be laundered back into a float, and Verdict.__bool__ raises so INDETERMINATE cannot be read as a pass.
breaker_behaviour_on_incomplete: Three outcomes, not two. A MEASURED breach fires (conservative direction for a loss limit). A complete non-breach is CLEAR. An INCOMPLETE non-breach is INDETERMINATE, never CLEAR: the type calls declare, a DEGRADED decision row names the gate and the excluded symbols, and the bot keeps running rather than standing down a whole book for one unresolvable symbol. Stated honestly, the P&L subtotal is NOT a bound in either direction because omitted terms can be gains or losses; only the portfolio-heat subtotal is a true lower bound, since every heat term is non-negative.
refusal_log_level: WARNING for the resolver refusals and every degraded-aggregate evaluation; the durable records are Decision rows with status SKIPPED (kind skipped_no_point_value) for refused entries and status DEGRADED for incomplete risk gates

app/interventions/stop_grade.py carries its own resolve_point_value with the SAME NAME and a STRONGER return type (KnownPointValue | UnknownPointValue discriminated union with provenance). Recommendation: keep the union as the public shape and have it delegate the raw lookup to presets.resolve_point_value. This PR adds a test asserting the two agree on every table key plus deliberate misses, and pins their one divergence (stop_grade upper-cases and strips its input, presets does not).
